findings.mechanism: Indicator closes its estimate at10:20 and creates a short F trigger4167.785. Strategy remains busy and observes its actual10:20 exit at10:25, then creates a different F trigger4164.96. At10:35 the shared Close-entry price4166.48 lies between those triggers. Indicator passes every check and selects F. Strategy remains unconfirmed. Its later10:50 confirmation fails STOP_DISTANCE and ENTRY_DISTANCE, then invalidates11:05.

Both models detect the same10:50 B candidate and confirm11:05. Indicator has5 session plans and fails only QUOTA. Strategy has4 and selects B with no failed checks. The extra Indicator10:35 F accounts for the one-plan quota difference.

Indicator frees its slot at08:25 and creates B with invalidation4093.25. Strategy is still busy then. At08:30 Indicator invalidates that candidate while Strategy observes its actual08:25 position exit, creates a new B with invalidation4094.165 and trigger4090.045, and selects it08:35 after all checks pass. Indicator has no B candidate at08:35. The source consumes each completed CRT reference on setup creation. Both setup bars (08:20 and08:25 opens) share the08:00 completed M15 reference, so the Indicator cannot reuse that consumed reference after invalidation.
findings.inferenceBoundary: ENGINE, setup identities, invalidation, empty Indicator state and Strategy checks/selection are native observations. The completed-reference08:00 identity and no-rearm explanation are derived from source request.security(crtTF,[high[1],low[1],time[1]],lookahead_on), actual15-minute CRT input, setup bar opens and memory.crtUsed assignment. The capture does not separately log memory.crtUsed.

limitations: These three mismatch mechanisms are established in the captured historical context. Strict full-history planned-field parity continues to fail.

CAPTURE_START/CAPTURE_END and continuous sequence verification establish internal structural completeness. The analyzer explicitly reports STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE_UNAUTHENTICATED because the log file has no independently authenticated export envelope.
Target windows are a subset of available history. Global trading research admission remains disabled. Counts describe observed window events and inherited engine state.
Strategy exits and costs are broker-emulator historical results. Indicator closure events are OHLC-model estimates.
Native runtime source and inputs are supported by preserved post-paste copy-backs and AX snapshots. This read-only analysis did not run new browser actions or Replay.
